written.headline: Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return
written.summary: Nvidia's board has approached Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO. Meanwhile, a petition by Nvidia employees to reinstate Huang has received backing from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.

written.headline: Tesla invites select customers to order Cybercab for personal use
written.summary: Tesla is offering select customers the ability to order its driverless Cybercab for personal use at a price of $29,990. Operating the vehicle requires a mandatory $299 per month Autonomy Subscription and is limited to supported service areas in Texas and Florida.

written.headline: Nvidia scandal looms over US-China AI safety talks
written.summary: US and Chinese leaders are preparing to discuss AI safety and a tech crisis hotline at the APEC meeting, while the Nvidia leadership scandal unfolds. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

written.headline: Trump not expected to raise Jensen Huang allegations in meeting with Xi
written.summary: US officials stated that President Donald Trump is not expected to raise allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang during his upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi.
